name: zinc fingers and homeoboxes 3

function.text: ZHX3 is the approved symbol for zinc fingers and homeoboxes 3. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in DNA-binding transcription factor activity; DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Bladder urothelial carcinoma; Colorectal carcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: ZHX3 encodes zinc fingers and homeoboxes 3. Its functions include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ZHX3 have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and bladder urothelial carcinoma.
